<x_0.0234><y_0.3609>"The second thing remarkable is the variation of the thermometer. <x_0.0186><y_0.4578>" The third is that remarkable flop in the extent of the rain northward, when the fun, that has con- ducted the vapours from the line, and fhould feem now more than ever to be in poffeffion of them, ia here over-ruled fuddenly; till, on its return to Gorri, again it refumes the abfolute command over the rain, and reconducts it to the Line, to furnish difant de- luges to the fouthward."<x_0.7461><y_0.575><class_Text>

Notwiththanding this, however, we find him afferting that the foil of Egypt has undoubtedly been augmented by the Nile: in which cafe it is not unrefonable to fuppofe that it has been produced by it altogether — "The reader (fays he) will conclude, doubtlefs, from what I have said, that writers have flattered themselves too much in fuppofing they could fix the precife limits of the enlargement and rifle of the Delta. But, though I would reject all illulory cir- cumfitances, I am far from denying the fact to be well founded; it is too plain from realon, and an examination of the country. The rifle of the ground appears to me demonstrated by an observation on which little firefs has been laid.
